# theoui — Complete Developer & Agent Reference

> Accessible, unstyled-first UI component and authentication library built on Base UI, Better Auth, and Tailwind CSS v4.

---

## 1. 3-Tier Architecture & Skill Delegation

When building applications with `theoui`, recognize the 3 distinct architectural layers:

1. **Layer 1: Base UI Primitives (`coss`)**
   - Basic accessible primitives (`Button`, `Dialog`, `Select`, `Drawer`, `Tabs`, `Input`, `Checkbox`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `Slider`, `Tooltip`, `Popover`, `Menu`, `Card`, `Badge`, `Separator`, `Skeleton`) follow standard Base UI composition rules.
   - For primitive APIs, styling, and Base UI patterns, refer to `.agents/skills/coss/SKILL.md` (or Coss UI).

2. **Layer 2: Pattern Blocks & Composed Recipes (`coss-particles`)**
   - Composed UI layouts (hero sections, pricing tables, dashboards, settings cards, activity feeds) are indexed in `.agents/skills/coss-particles/SKILL.md` and `https://coss.com/ui/particles`.
   - Prefer searching and installing particle snippets for standard block patterns.

3. **Layer 3: Application Framework & Domain System (`theoui`)**
   - Complete Better Auth UI views & plugins (`theoui/auth` and `theoui/auth/lib`).
   - Exclusive advanced domain widgets not available in Coss (`Gantt`, `Kanban`, `EventCalendar`, `Filters`, `Composer`, `Chat Feed`, `AutoHeight`, micro-buttons).
   - Shared utility functions (`theoui/lib`) and hooks (`theoui/hooks`).

---

## 2. Installation & Setup

### Package Installation
```bash
pnpm add theoui @base-ui/react better-auth @better-auth-ui/react lucide-react
```

### Stylesheet Import
Import the precompiled Tailwind CSS v4 stylesheet in your root layout:
```css
/* app/globals.css or layout.tsx */
@import "theoui/styles.css";
```

---

## 3. Public Subpath Import Specifications

Always import from the 5 designated public subpaths:

```tsx
// 1. General Primitives & Advanced Widgets
import {
  Button,
  Dialog,
  Drawer,
  Select,
  Tabs,
  Gantt,
  Kanban,
  EventCalendar,
  Filters,
  Composer,
  MessageScroller,
  Message,
  Bubble,
  Trace,
  AutoHeight,
  HoldButton,
  RainbowButton,
  ShimmerButton,
  UndoButton,
  CartButton,
} from "theoui";

// 2. Auth Views & Hooks (Client Boundary)
import {
  AuthProvider,
  SignIn,
  SignUp,
  SignOut,
  UserButton,
  UserAvatar,
  Settings,
  Organization,
  AdminUsers,
  useSession,
  useAuth,
  useActiveOrganization,
} from "theoui/auth";

// 3. Better Auth Client Plugins
import {
  adminPlugin,
  organizationPlugin,
  twoFactorPlugin,
  passkeyPlugin,
  apiKeyPlugin,
  ssoPlugin,
  magicLinkPlugin,
} from "theoui/auth/lib";

// 4. Reusable React Hooks
import {
  useMediaQuery,
  useAutoHeight,
  useComposerEditor,
  useIsHydrated,
} from "theoui/hooks";

// 5. Shared Utilities
import {
  cn,
  createSyntaxHighlighter,
  getComposerQueryRanges,
} from "theoui/lib";
```

---

## 4. RSC & Next.js Boundaries

- **`"theoui"` root index is RSC-neutral**: Contains server-renderable components (`Card`, `Badge`, `Separator`, `Skeleton`, etc.) as well as client-interactive widgets marked with `"use client"` at their leaf level. Never place `"use client"` on the root index.
- **`"theoui/auth"` carries `"use client"`**: Better-Auth UI and hooks depend on React contexts from `@better-auth-ui/react`. The entrypoint carries `"use client"`, allowing Next.js Server Components (like catch-all route pages) to import `<Settings />` or `<Organization />` directly without crashing the RSC runtime.

---

## 5. Better Auth Recipes

### Provider Setup (Client Layout)
```tsx
// components/providers.tsx
"use client";

import { AuthProvider } from "theoui/auth";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";

export function Providers({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <AuthProvider authClient={authClient}>{children}</AuthProvider>;
}
```

### Next.js Catch-All Settings View (Server Component Page)
```tsx
// app/(dashboard)/settings/[...path]/page.tsx
import { Settings } from "theoui/auth";

export default async function SettingsCatchAllPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ path: string[] }>;
}) {
  const { path } = await params;
  const resolvedPath = path?.join("/") ?? "account";

  return <Settings path={resolvedPath} />;
}
```

### Next.js Catch-All Organization View (Server Component Page)
```tsx
// app/(dashboard)/organization/[...path]/page.tsx
import { Organization } from "theoui/auth";

export default async function OrganizationCatchAllPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ path: string[] }>;
}) {
  const { path } = await params;
  const resolvedPath = path?.join("/") ?? "general";

  return <Organization path={resolvedPath} />;
}
```

### Dedicated Admin Users Management (Client Component Page)
```tsx
// app/(dashboard)/admin/users/page.tsx
"use client";

import { AdminUsers } from "theoui/auth";

export default function AdminUsersPage() {
  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto py-8">
      <AdminUsers />
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

## 6. Exclusive Advanced Components

### 6.1 Kanban Board
```tsx
"use client";

import { Kanban, KanbanBoard, KanbanColumn, KanbanCard } from "theoui";
import { useState } from "react";

const initialColumns = [
  { id: "todo", title: "To Do", items: [{ id: "1", title: "Set up project" }] },
  { id: "in-progress", title: "In Progress", items: [{ id: "2", title: "Implement Auth" }] },
  { id: "done", title: "Done", items: [] },
];

export function ProjectKanban() {
  const [columns, setColumns] = useState(initialColumns);

  return (
    <KanbanBoard onDragEnd={({ active, over }) => { /* handle card drop */ }}>
      {columns.map((col) => (
        <KanbanColumn key={col.id} id={col.id} title={col.title}>
          {col.items.map((item) => (
            <KanbanCard key={item.id} id={item.id}>
              {item.title}
            </KanbanCard>
          ))}
        </KanbanColumn>
      ))}
    </KanbanBoard>
  );
}
```

### 6.2 Gantt Chart
```tsx
"use client";

import { Gantt } from "theoui";

const tasks = [
  { id: "1", name: "Design Phase", start: new Date(2026, 0, 1), end: new Date(2026, 0, 15), progress: 100 },
  { id: "2", name: "Engineering Sprint", start: new Date(2026, 0, 10), end: new Date(2026, 1, 15), progress: 40 },
];

export function ProjectTimeline() {
  return (
    <div className="h-[400px] w-full border rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
      <Gantt tasks={tasks} viewMode="Month" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### 6.3 Event Calendar
```tsx
"use client";

import { EventCalendar } from "theoui";
import { useState } from "react";

export function TeamCalendar() {
  const [events, setEvents] = useState([
    { id: "1", title: "Product Launch", start: new Date(), end: new Date(), allDay: true },
  ]);

  return (
    <EventCalendar
      events={events}
      view="month"
      onEventClick={(event) => console.log(event)}
    />
  );
}
```

### 6.4 Chat Feed & Composer
```tsx
"use client";

import {
  MessageScroller,
  Message,
  Bubble,
  Trace,
  Composer,
  ComposerInput,
  ComposerSubmit,
} from "theoui";
import { useState } from "react";

export function ChatInterface() {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([
    { id: "1", role: "assistant", content: "Hello! How can I help you today?" },
  ]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-[600px] border rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-background">
      <MessageScroller className="flex-1 p-4 space-y-4">
        {messages.map((m) => (
          <Message key={m.id} role={m.role}>
            <Bubble variant={m.role === "user" ? "user" : "assistant"}>
              {m.content}
            </Bubble>
          </Message>
        ))}
      </MessageScroller>

      <div className="p-4 border-t bg-muted/20">
        <Composer value={input} onChange={setInput} onSubmit={() => { /* submit */ }}>
          <ComposerInput placeholder="Ask anything..." />
          <ComposerSubmit />
        </Composer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### 6.5 Interactive Micro-Buttons
```tsx
import {
  HoldButton,
  RainbowButton,
  ShimmerButton,
  UndoButton,
  CartButton,
} from "theoui";

export function MicroButtonExamples() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
      <HoldButton duration={1500} onComplete={() => alert("Deleted!")}>
        Hold to Delete
      </HoldButton>

      <RainbowButton onClick={() => console.log("Sparkle")}>
        Special Action
      </RainbowButton>

      <ShimmerButton onClick={() => console.log("Shimmer")}>
        Upgrade to Pro
      </ShimmerButton>

      <UndoButton onUndo={() => console.log("Undone")}>
        Saved
      </UndoButton>

      <CartButton count={3} onClick={() => console.log("Cart")} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

## 7. Anti-Patterns & Common Mistakes

- ❌ **`asChild` prop**: Base UI does not support Radix `asChild`. Always use `render={<Element />}`.
- ❌ **`Sheet` component**: `Sheet` is deprecated. Use `Drawer`.
- ❌ **Internal imports**: Never do `import { Button } from "theoui/components/button"`. Use `import { Button } from "theoui"`.
- ❌ **Utility import**: Never do `import { cn } from "theoui/utils"`. Use `import { cn } from "theoui/lib"`.
- ❌ **"use client" on UI root**: Never add `"use client"` to `packages/ui/src/index.ts`. Keep Server Components pure.
- ❌ **Duplicating primitive docs**: Refer to `.agents/skills/coss/` for standard Base UI primitive patterns; reserve `theoui` for subpaths, Better Auth UI, and exclusive advanced widgets.
- ❌ **Hardcoded colors**: Never use hardcoded values like `text-gray-500` or `bg-blue-600`. Use semantic theme tokens (`text-muted-foreground`, `bg-primary`, `bg-background`).
